settings.title: Ribbon Folder settings
settings.description: Pin commands, files, or web links directly on the Ribbon, or group them behind folder buttons with pop-up menus.

iconFolder.name: Icon folder
iconFolder.description: Custom icon root directory. Icons can be Lucide names (e.g. dice), .svg files relative to this directory (e.g. add.svg), or full vault paths.

addFolder.name: New group
addFolder.description: Add a new button group to the Ribbon

defaultFileOpenLocation.name: Default file open location
defaultFileOpenLocation.description: Where files open by default. Each file item can override this.

defaultWebOpenLocation.name: Default web open location
defaultWebOpenLocation.description: Where web links open by default. Each web item can override this.

pinsPage.name: Shortcuts
pinsPage.description: Choose which commands, files, or web links appear directly on the ribbon.

groupsPage.name: Groups
groupsPage.description: Organize commands behind ribbon group buttons with pop-up menus.

folder.deleteDescription: Remove this group and its menu items from the ribbon.
folder.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the group "{{name}}"?
folder.name: Name
folder.menuDisplayDescription: How each command appears in the menu
folder.triggerModeDescription: Show the menu on click or on hover

edit.title: Edit Command
edit.displayDescription: Name displayed in menu (leave blank to use command's original name)

web.openBlocked: Cannot open this link (invalid or unsafe URL).

edit.title: Edit web link
edit.urlDescription: Address to open in your browser.
edit.displayDescription: Label in the menu (leave blank to use the URL)

edit.title: Edit file
edit.pathDescription: Vault path to the file (e.g. Folder/Document.pdf).
edit.displayDescription: Label in the menu (leave blank to use the file name)
edit.iconDescription: Lucide name (default by extension, e.g. file / file-text) or .svg path
edit.iconPlaceholder: leave blank for default, or file-text / add.svg

pinEdit.displayDescriptionCommand: Tooltip on the ribbon action button (leave blank to use the command name)
pinEdit.displayDescriptionNote: Tooltip on the ribbon action button (leave blank to use the file name)
pinEdit.displayDescriptionWeb: Tooltip on the ribbon action button (leave blank to use the URL)

openLocation.name: Open in
openLocation.entryDescription: Choose Default to follow the global setting.

plugin.noGroupsYet: Create a group in Ribbon Folder settings first.

svgIcon.emptyState: No .svg files in icon folder. You can place icons in this directory or use Lucide icon names directly (e.g., dice).
